summary: Probe a general list-settings handler without leaving test data behind.

evidence.observed_change: A disposable Kitchen Notes list read back ALListItemSortOrderAlphabetical after the handler was applied.
evidence.cleanup: The disposable list was deleted and verified absent.

limitations: The probe's attempt to restore an empty original sort-order value did not read back, so the handler's clear/default encoding remains unknown.
This is evidence for one field only; other settings handlers still need independent live round trips.
validated_outcome: The CLI remains fail-closed for general settings writes until a safe update/restore contract is implemented.
